summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Indian PII redaction tool for Word documents. Both backend API and frontend UI working perfectly with full integration.
passed_tests: File upload /api/redact processes .docx and returns redacted document with stats
Backend correctly rejects non-.docx files with 400 error
Backend correctly rejects large files (>10MB) with 400 error
Backend returns 422 for missing file parameter
Frontend loads with dark theme and RedactAI branding
PII Types dropdown displays all 16 expected categories
Upload zone with drag-and-drop functionality works
File processing shows processing state during API call
Results panel displays stats grid with 15 PII category cards
Total count shows 20 PII items detected across 15 categories
Download button functional for redacted document
Start Over button resets application to upload state
Privacy footer displays 3 privacy assurance points
Success toast notification shows 'Redacted 20 PII items'
Error toast notification shows for invalid file uploads
All expected Indian PII types detected: Aadhaar, PAN, Phone, Email, Passport, Voter ID, IFSC, GST, UPI, Vehicle Registration, Names, Locations, PIN Code, Address, Date of Birth
